p: Tamar: Tamar was Absalom's sister both by father and mother, and Amnon's only by father.
virgin: And therefore kept her father's house, as virgins were accustomed.
Lay thee down on thy bed: Here we see that there is no enterprise so wicked that it cannot be encouraged to further wickedness.
cakes in my sight: Meaning, some delicate and dainty meat.
poured them out before him: That is, she served them on a dish.
me: For the wicked are ashamed to do that before men, which they are not afraid to commit in the sight of God.
the fools in Israel: As a lewd and wicked person.
divers colours upon her: For that which was of various colours or pieces, in those days was greatly esteemed, Ge 37:3, Jud 5:30.
hold now thy peace: For though he conceived sudden vengeance in his heart, yet he concealed it till an opportunity arose, and comforted his sister.
Absalom invited all the king's sons: That is, to a banquet, thinking by it to fulfil his wicked purpose.
Amnon go with us: Pretending to the king that Amnon was most dear to him.
I commanded you: Such is the pride of the wicked masters, that in all their wicked commandments they think to be obeyed.
earth: Lamenting, as he that felt the wrath of God on his house, 2Sa 12:10.
so it is: That only Amnon is dead.
Talmai: For Maachah his mother was the daughter of this Talmai, 2Sa 3:3.
